name: Find Enriched Motifs With Homer
description: Find DNA sequence motifs enriched in genomic regions using the HOMER motif discovery software.
detailed_description: Find DNA sequence motifs enriched in genomic regions using the HOMER motif discovery software.
when_to_use: When you need find enriched motifs with homer analysis

parameters.peak_file: [Required] Path to peak file in BED format containing genomic regions to analyze for motif enrichment (str)
parameters.genome: [Optional] Reference genome for sequence extraction (default: hg38)
parameters.background_file: [Optional] Path to BED file with background regions for comparison. If None, HOMER will generate random background sequences automatically
parameters.motif_length: [Optional] Comma-separated list of motif lengths to discover (default: 8,10,12)
parameters.threads: [Optional] Number of CPU threads to use (default: 4)
